title: Immersive Crafting
lines: Gather sticks and stones from trees and rocks (hold F).
Drop 2 stones and 2 pieces of wood together on open ground,
then hold F to build a firepit — every craft starts at a fire.

title: Firepit built
lines: You can cook here — and pit-fire clay into bricks (slowly,
and some will crack). Dig clay at the waterside with a shovel.
Six good bricks and some clay build a kiln.

title: Kiln built
lines: The kiln fires ceramics and molds reliably. Shape raw molds
at a crafting table, burn them here, then cast metal in them.
Eight bricks and a crucible build a furnace.

title: Furnace built
lines: The furnace smelts ore into ingots and casts them in burnt
molds — armor and weapons, if you have the metal for it.
Melt down old gear to reclaim ingots.

title: Charcoal pit built
lines: Load it with wood and light it with a fire in hand.
Charcoal burns three times as long as wood — kilns and
furnaces want it, and steel cannot be made without it.
